::: {.why}
Queue position is the single most valuable thing a passive order owns, and understanding why is what stops you from writing a backtest that fills at the touch every time.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Trace a marketable buy order through a book with three price levels and say exactly which resting orders it trades against and in what order.
- Explain why two orders at the same price are not worth the same, and what that is worth in a tick.
